in_scope.name: Izzat
in_scope.other_work: I look after the twelve computers in my father's accounting firm. When the shared printer or the scanner stops working I find out why and fix it. I set up new laptops for the staff and copy their files across. I renew the antivirus licences and check that the nightly backup ran.

in_scope.name: Lim
in_scope.other_work: At the electronics store I set up customers' new phones and laptops before they leave. I move their contacts and photos from the old device. When a customer's wifi will not connect I talk them through it on the phone. I log every repair job in our service system.

in_scope.name: Ganesh
in_scope.other_work: I installed the CCTV cameras and the network video recorder at my temple and keep them running. I run the network cables and crimp the connectors myself. I set up the router so the committee can watch the cameras from their phones. When a camera goes offline I trace the fault with a cable tester.

in_scope.name: Farah
in_scope.other_work: I am the IT volunteer for a women's shelter. I create email accounts for new staff and remove them when people leave. I keep a list of every laptop, who has it and when its warranty ends. I teach the staff how to spot phishing emails. When something breaks I contact the supplier and follow up until it is fixed.

in_scope.name: Wei Jie
in_scope.other_work: I write small web apps in React for friends' businesses. I build the forms that take bookings and store them in a database. I write tests so that a change does not break the booking flow. I review my friend's code before he merges it.

in_scope.name: Haziq
in_scope.other_work: I automate my office's spreadsheets with Python so the monthly figures come out in one click. I wrote a script that pulls our sales from the online shop every night. When the script fails I read the error and fix it. I keep notes in the repository so someone else can run it.

in_scope.name: Amira
in_scope.other_work: I design and build websites for small hotels with WordPress. I change the theme's code when an owner wants a different layout. I make the pages work well on phones and load quickly. I update the room prices and photos every season.

in_scope.name: Ken
in_scope.other_work: I test mobile banking apps as a freelancer on a crowd-testing platform. For each task I follow the test steps and record what fails, with screenshots. I retest the bugs after the developers fix them. I suggest changes when a screen is confusing to use.

in_scope.name: Nadia
in_scope.other_work: I do the bookkeeping for three hawker stalls. Every week I enter their receipts and bills into an accounting app. At the end of the month I prepare a simple profit and loss statement for each stall. I check that their bank balance matches the records and chase any missing receipts.

in_scope.name: Hanif
in_scope.other_work: I manage the money for our family's rental houses. I track the rent coming in and the repair costs going out in a spreadsheet. Each year I work out whether the rents cover the loan payments and taxes. I explain the numbers to my parents before we decide whether to sell a house.

in_scope.name: Priyanka
in_scope.other_work: I make the weekly stock and sales dashboard for the warehouse where I work. I pull the numbers from our system into Excel and clean up the errors. I make charts that show which items are running low. I present the dashboard to the supervisor every Monday.

in_scope.name: Desmond
in_scope.other_work: I help my aunt's money-lending co-operative decide on loan applications. I check each applicant's income documents and past repayments. I calculate how much they can borrow and the monthly instalment. I write a short note recommending approval or not.

out_of_scope.name: Aiman
out_of_scope.other_work: I breed and sell guppies from tanks in my garage. I check the fish every day and treat the sick ones. I pack the orders and send them by courier.

out_of_scope.name: Sofia
out_of_scope.other_work: I volunteer on a youth helpline on weekend nights. I listen to callers and help them think through their problems. I refer callers at risk to the counsellor on duty.

out_of_scope.name: Rahul
out_of_scope.other_work: I restore old motorcycles and sell them. I rebuild the engines and respray the frames. I take photos and write the listings for each bike.
